title: ctDNA as a Assisted Diagnosis, Early Intervention and Prognostic Marker for Peritoneal Metastases From Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: This is a prospective, open-label, randomized controlled clinical trial, by monitoring the serum ctDNA mutational profile using NGS, aiming to elucidate the correlation between the postoperative ctDNA status and the assisted diagnosis, early intervention and prognosis for colorectal cancer peritoneal metastases.
